status: experimental; equivalent native vocabulary checks passed, pipeline replay pending
change: Parse valid text nodes without repeated descriptor stringstreams and retain descriptor bytes in one shared cv::Mat allocation. Vocabulary class layout is unchanged.

native_checks.hash_scope: All valid node IDs, parent IDs, weights, descriptor bytes and valid child IDs
native_checks.query_scope: 30000 seeded random descriptors plus ORB descriptors from 160 dataset images
native_checks.scope: Native vocabulary check executable, not full estimator

eof_correction.explanation: The legacy while-not-eof loop creates an extra invalid node after the final newline. The reader retains every valid text node and omits that artifact.

limits: Valid nodes and sampled word lookups match; the invalid EOF node is intentionally removed. Native loader time/RSS do not establish whole-pipeline savings or trajectory equivalence. Full replay and hardware validation remain.
